integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete character-orthogonality proof, with a standalone integer checker supplied as supplementary corroboration. Prior sources are identified; neither independent mathematical validation nor global historical priority is claimed.
limitations: The theorem concerns all vertex-coordinate additive characters of proper ternary colourings of K_{2,n} only. It does not treat other palettes or arbitrary graphs. The full 2012 Babson-Beck paper could not be inspected; an equivalent prior character-weighted formula remains possible.
title: Complete ternary Fourier spectrum of the proper colourings of \(K_{2,n}\)
